title: WLU Failure Taxonomy (429-like)
summary: WLU distinguishes between entitlement, capacity, and throughput exhaustion to guide scheduler reactions.
why: A throughput shortfall is a capacity problem (can be solved by scaling/throttling), whereas entitlement exhaustion is a budget problem (cannot be solved by scaling).
invariants: WLU_CAPACITY_EXHAUSTED: Temporary token/burst capacity unavailable (may carry retryAfterSeconds).
WLU_THROUGHPUT_EXHAUSTED: Requested WLU/s delivery rate cannot be reserved.
evidence_note: Source: oorexx_work_load_units_v0.12/README.md:120-130. Line 122-128 list the specific exhaustion results.
